svg.text: PRODUCTIVE · COGNITIVE ENHANCEMENT · PART 3.0 / 8th of the track
DIAGNOSE THE LEVER, NOT THE MENU.
Match the failing lever, then take the lowest tier that fixes it.
TIER 1 — Rx, controlled in MY · high-stakes only
TIER 3 — experimental · you are the study
single-pole · one detent at a time
modafinil: modest on a rested brain → fix sleep first
amphetamine tax → PEACEFUL ↓ · HEALTHY ↓ · bad on gear
* ~46% higher 10-yr stroke signal (TMAO) · not high-dose daily
driving BOTH hard does not add memory
clipping · jagged comedown · costs other pillars
a thumbnail of the board above — not a shopping list
the destination is the lit middle trunk, reached by diagnosis — not the locked top
